name: Flight 8
summary: Booster 15 returned to OLP-1 and was caught by the tower at T+7:02, despite engine relight problems during its landing burn. Ship 34 lost four of its six engines starting about T+8:04, shortly before planned engine cutoff, then lost attitude control and broke up. SpaceX traced the loss to a hardware failure in one sea-level Raptor that let propellants mix and ignite, which was distinct from the Flight 7 failure. The breakup was seen from Florida, the Bahamas, Jamaica, and the Turks and Caicos Islands.
highlights: Ship lost four of six engines near the end of ascent
Breakup seen from Florida and the Bahamas
Four Starlink simulators onboard, not deployed
